sourceOfTruth.scope: framework-neutral properties, attributes, events, slots, methods, form semantics, value/model state, refs, accessibility, first-class framework support, implementation state, and framework facade mappings

eventVocabulary.name: vf-value-change
eventVocabulary.purpose: A component value changed after a user or controller transition.

eventVocabulary.name: vf-open-change
eventVocabulary.purpose: An overlay or expandable surface changed open state.

eventVocabulary.name: vf-checked-change
eventVocabulary.purpose: A checked or mixed state changed.

eventVocabulary.name: vf-action
eventVocabulary.purpose: A primary component action was invoked.

eventVocabulary.name: vf-dismiss
eventVocabulary.purpose: A dismissible surface requested or completed dismissal.

eventVocabulary.name: vf-invalid
eventVocabulary.purpose: A form-associated component reported invalid state.

eventVocabulary.name: vf-reset
eventVocabulary.purpose: A form-associated component restored its initial state.

eventVocabulary.name: vf-input-value-change
eventVocabulary.purpose: A composite input's editable query text changed independently of its selected value.

eventVocabulary.name: vf-toast-change
eventVocabulary.purpose: The toast viewport record collection changed.

slotVocabulary.name: trigger
slotVocabulary.purpose: Element that controls a composite or overlay.

slotVocabulary.name: item
slotVocabulary.purpose: Collection item template or projected item.

slotVocabulary.name: status
slotVocabulary.purpose: Status content associated with a heading.

formAssociation.fallbackPolicy: A fallback may be added only for a documented target-browser gap and must preserve the same public contract.

accessibility: preserves native description-list semantics for term and description relationships
projected content must retain semantic term and description structure rather than generic grouping roles
requires exactly one native table element as projected content so table, row, column, header, and cell relationships remain browser semantics
the table should provide a caption or another accessible name when surrounding context does not already identify its purpose
header cells must use native th semantics with scope or explicit header associations appropriate to the table structure
responsive presentation may scroll or wrap but must not replace table semantics with generic or ARIA grid roles
owns one native ordered-list container so chronological order remains explicit browser list semantics
projected timeline entries must become native list items and preserve source order without visual reordering that changes chronological meaning
timestamps must have understandable visible text and should use native time semantics with a machine-readable datetime value when available
the component is read-only presentation and must not introduce feed, listbox, grid, selection, or live-region semantics unless a separate interactive contract requires them
grouping container without implicit interactive semantics
layout-only semantics; child accessibility remains intact
layout-only semantics; child accessibility remains intact
status or alert role follows severity
text remains available to assistive technology
status or alert role follows severity

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current determinate value; null represents indeterminate progress.

accessibility: preserves native progressbar semantics for determinate and indeterminate states
determinate progress exposes the current value and maximum while a null value represents indeterminate progress
progress must have an accessible name when surrounding context does not provide one
layout does not replace child navigation labels
side placement does not change semantics
code text remains readable by assistive technology
meaningful icons expose img role and accessible label

catalogCoverage.coverageRule: Every public beta-included non-grid VyrnForge component record is either contract-complete or covered by an active narrow framework exception.
